App details

Ott e!

A touch game for cats, with moving prey and play settings you can adjust.

Coming soonIn developmentAndroid

What it’s for

A moving prey appears one at a time for the cat to chase and tap. Each species moves differently and reacts to successful touches. Choose playtime and prey before starting; settings stay hidden while the cat plays.

Main features

  • Fly, mosquito, ladybird, beetle, cockroach, grasshopper and spider.
  • Choose 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 20 minutes, plus prey, sound and vibration.
  • Full-screen play on tablets and phones.
  • Offline, ad-free play without an account.

Coming soon. The game is implemented and being prepared for public availability; a closed test is not a public release.

How to use

On the start screen, choose one or more of the seven prey species, a play time from one to twenty minutes, and sound or vibration. Press Start and put the device safely in front of your cat. One prey moves at a time; touches change its behaviour. The timer ends the session, and settings are kept away from normal play touches.

Important limits

Supervise the cat and protect the device from claws, falls and biting. Screen response, sound and vibration depend on the device. This is enrichment play, not an assessment of an animal’s health or guaranteed interest.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

All gameplay works offline; voluntary website and email actions are separate.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

The game requires no camera, microphone, contacts or location. Opening privacy, contact or voluntary support uses the browser or email app separately.

Local data

Play time, selected species, sound, vibration, language and theme are saved locally. Images, movement and sounds are local resources. There is no account or automatic upload of play data.

Advertising and purchases

The game works offline, without ads or in-app purchases. Optional support opens the JN86 website and gives no gameplay benefit.

First version and later ideas

The current implemented game is being prepared for public availability.

The current game has seven prey species and timed play. Online competitions, cloud profiles and advertising are not included.

Availability

Coming soon. The game is implemented and being prepared for public availability; a closed test is not a public release.
